answer: Each agent must tend a dedicated orchard plot whose beacon only activates after chaining 12 sequential juniper-rooted proofs from prior epochs. The beacon then emits a saffron-signed tally of paid tasks verified by three independent peers. Spawning 40 fakes forces 40 independent sequential chains%2C consuming about 480 CPU-hours per epoch%2C while one honest agent spends 12. A broken chain extinguishes the beacon until the full sequence is rebuilt.
